g.title: XALD_QSP
g.text: X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy · Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map

One lesion (ABCD1 loss), two independent variables — measurable VLCFA accumulation (reachable from the periphery) vs unmeasurable bistable cerebral inflammation switch (reachable only from inside the CNS)

g.text: 4. Cellular stress — mitochondria · ROS · autophagy · Nrf2

Adrenocortical axis: an independent third axis

g.title: cluster_mgl
g.text: 7. Microglia — they die before demyelination (a pre-lesional event)

g.text: 8. Self-amplifying neuroinflammatory loop — what the bistable switch actually is

g.text: 9. Blood-brain barrier — the line drugs cannot cross
The line most drugs cannot cross

g.title: cluster_myelin
g.text: 10. Cerebral myelin · axons — the Schaumburg three-zone lesion

Phenotype determination: same mutation, different disease

g.text: 14. Newborn screening · surveillance (early diagnosis is what creates the only therapeutic window)

g.title: cluster_drugmet
g.text: 15. Metabolism-targeting drugs — they reach variable (1) only

g.title: cluster_drugcns
g.text: 16. CNS-penetrant · anti-inflammatory drugs — aimed at variable (2)

HSCT / ex-vivo gene therapy: replaces microglia, not metabolism

Replacement: reverses the adrenal axis only

g.text: the more skewed, the more expressed

g.text: (the largest negative result in this disease)

g.text: G > 1 and it cannot be reversed

g.text: (the only in-vivo marker of an active lesion)
